## Context
Discovered while unblocking pm-brief's stuck Daily Release (pm-brief#14). Two related, fleet-wide changelog-quality issues surfaced. Filing for a focused follow-up rather than a rushed cascade.

## 1. Released changelogs contain duplicated entries
The release workflow generates the changelog with `--mode prepend ... --release-version-from-package --since-previous-tag --until-release-tag`. Prepend does a heading-keyed incremental merge that **preserves** any existing `## Unreleased` section. So when a release bumps the version, prepend writes `## <version>` on top but leaves the prior `## Unreleased` (mirroring the same items) in place.

Result: every released CHANGELOG.md ends up with a `## <version>` section **and** a duplicate `## Unreleased` section listing the identical items. Confirmed present today in e.g. pm-context (`## 2026.6.13` + `## Unreleased`, same item `pm-context-wvup`) and would occur for pm-brief.

**Proposed fix:** in prepend mode with `--release-version-from-package`, treat a leading `## Unreleased` as the pending-release section and **rename/merge** it into `## <version>` rather than emitting a second section alongside it. (Standard 'Keep a Changelog' semantics: Unreleased → the version it ships in.)

## 2. Fleet-wide changelog:check / generation drift risk
The root cause of pm-brief's failure was that its `changelog:check` used `--mode replace --all-release-tags` while generation used `--mode prepend` — the check validated a different artifact than what shipped, and failed once unreleased-but-closed items existed at release time.

- pm-context already avoids this by using prepend-mode for its check.
- **15 other fleet repos** (pm-beads, pm-csv, pm-gantt-chart, pm-github, pm-graph, pm-jira, pm-linear, pm-presets, pm-slack, pm-slack-standup, pm-starter, pm-todos, pm-ts-starter, pm-web, and pm-changelog itself) still use `--mode replace` for `changelog:check`. They pass today only because they have no unreleased-but-closed items at release time, but share the same latent failure mode.

**Proposed fix:** standardize every repo's `changelog:check` to `npm run changelog -- --check` (forward `--check` into the generation script) so the check is definitionally identical to generation and cannot drift. Applied to pm-brief in pm-brief#14 per Gemini's review.

## Scope note
Both fixes touch the whole fleet (tooling behavior + 16 package scripts + regenerating committed changelogs). Worth a dedicated, carefully-verified pass.
